controles.affirmation: Citation presentee comme verbatim : "the Toll Roads and Airports divisions represented approximately 89% of its valuation"
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025, Item 3.D Risk Factors : "According to market analysts' reports, HIGHWAYS AND AIRPORTS AMOUNTED TO APPROXIMATELY 89% OF OUR VALUATION AS OF DECEMBER 2025."
controles.correction_proposee: Le fond est exact (89%, decembre 2025, selon les rapports d'analystes de marche), mais la phrase entre guillemets n'existe pas dans le 20-F : "Highways" a ete remplace par "Toll Roads", "amounted to" par "represented", "our" par "its", et le mot "divisions" ajoute. Restituer le verbatim exact ou retirer les guillemets.

controles.affirmation: Budimex, filiale polonaise du groupe, represente 23,3% du chiffre d'affaires 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025, 3.D.1.1 : "Our activities in Poland (through the construction business of Budimex S,A - 'Budimex'), as a neighboring country to Ukraine, are at an increased risk of being disrupted by the conflict. While OUR REVENUE GENERATED IN POLAND, which, in 2025, amounted to 23.3% OF OUR REVENUES was not materially affected as a result of the conflict, the risk that such impact may materialize in the future cannot be excluded."
controles.correction_proposee: Les 23,3% sont le chiffre d'affaires genere EN POLOGNE, pas le chiffre d'affaires de Budimex. Budimex est l'operation principale du groupe en Pologne mais les deux perimetres ne sont pas identiques. Ecrire : "la Pologne, ou le groupe opere via Budimex, represente 23,3% du chiffre d'affaires 2025". Le 20-F precise en outre que ce chiffre d'affaires n'a PAS ete materiellement affecte par le conflit a ce jour, nuance absente de l'ATT.

controles.affirmation: En decembre 2025 un incident arme sur la concession Ruta del Cacao en Colombie a detruit la barriere de peage de La Lizama
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025, 3.D.1.1 : "a serious public order incident took place in December 2025 at our toll road concession Ruta del Cacao in Colombia (where we hold a 30.0% stake), at the La Lizama toll station, that involved a discharge of firearms and detonation of an explosive device resulting in injury to an individual, the destruction of the La Lizama toll infrastructure, and temporary suspension of toll operations. WHILE THE OVERALL IMPACT TO THE COMPANY WAS LIMITED, other similar types of violent events or threats thereof could have a material impact on our operations and business."
controles.correction_proposee: Fait exact. Reserve de forme : l'ATT omet la phrase suivante du 20-F, qui qualifie l'impact global comme limite, et ne mentionne pas que Ferrovial ne detient que 30,0% de cette concession. Ajouter ces deux precisions eviterait un effet de dramatisation.

controles.affirmation: Le risque geopolitique est passe en premiere position du chapitre facteurs de risque du 20-F FY2025, contre une position intermediaire l'annee precedente
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025 : "3.D.1 Business Environment and Macroeconomic Factors / 3.D.1.1 Major conflicts, acts of violence and geopolitical unrest could have a negative impact on our business." (premiere position). 20-F FY2024 : "3.D.1 Risks Related to Our Business and Structure / 3.D.1.1 Global economic and political conditions...", le risque conflits/violence figurant en 3.D.1.7 ("The conflicts in Ukraine and in the Middle East...") et 3.D.1.15 ("Acts of violence, geopolitical unrest, catastrophic events...").

controles.affirmation: Le retard du NTO peut declencher des penalites et des demandes d'indemnites : "may have significant adverse consequences for NTO, including potential penalties and damages claims pursuant to those arrangements" ; impacts reputationnels pour Ferrovial ET NTO aupres des compagnies aeriennes et fournisseurs
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025, Item 3.D : "The expected delay in the completion of the first phase of construction has the potential to trigger various contractual rights and obligations of NTO (including the presentation of a remedial plan under the NTO Lease) and its counterparties in connection with this project and, depending on the determinations and actions under these arrangements, may have significant adverse consequences for NTO, including potential penalties and damages claims pursuant to those arrangements. The expected delay or any other developments in the construction of NTO could have adverse impacts on NTO and Ferrovial, including reputational impacts on NTO and Ferrovial and impacts on NTO's relationships and prospects with airlines and vendors."

controles.affirmation: Au 30 juin 2026, un plan de remediation a ete depose fixant la date de mise en service (Phase A DBO) a mars 2027, apres un objectif initial de juin 2026 puis d'automne 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 6-K S1 2026 (FER_2026-07-28, interim management report) : "Airports: New Terminal One (JFK) has submitted a completion remedial plan with March 2027 as the date for Phase A DBO." et "Design Builder missed the Phase A DBO (Date of Beneficial Occupancy) milestone on June 1. NTO has submitted a completion remedial plan with March 2027 as the date for Phase A DBO. As of June 2026, JFK New Terminal One reached 92% overall physical progress." 20-F FY2025 : "...completion date for the first phase of construction to occur during Fall 2026."
controles.correction_proposee: Precision : c'est NTO (la societe de projet, detenue a 49% et mise en equivalence) qui a depose le plan de remediation, tandis que c'est le "Design Builder" qui a manque le jalon du 1er juin. L'ATT ecrit "Le constructeur... a annonce", ce qui melange les deux roles. A noter aussi que le 6-K signale 92% d'avancement physique, element de contexte absent de l'ATT.

controles.affirmation: Les autorites publiques concedantes conservent un droit de resiliation unilaterale pour motif d'interet general ; la concession de Dalaman prevoit expressement une resiliation unilaterale
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025, Item 3.D : "the relevant government authority, as the concession grantor or lessor, has... a right to terminate the concession/lease unilaterally if such governmental authority determines that such termination is in its best interests, oftentimes referred to as a right to terminate for convenience." Et : "the concession agreement for the operation of the airport terminals at Dalaman expressly allows the administration to terminate the concession unilaterally and, in the event of a unilateral termination, the administration must pay to the concessionaire a termination fee for the loss of revenue corresponding to the remaining concession period at the time of termination, as determined by independent international audit firms." Sur les litiges d'indemnisation : "disputes may arise between the parties as to the ultimate amount of such compensation, the method used to calculate the same or related interpretation of the contract and applicable provisions."

controles.affirmation: Resultat net part du groupe de 3 239 M€ en 2024 a 888 M€ en 2025 (-72,6%) ; BPA de 4,47 € a 1,24 € ; resultat d'exploitation de 3 109 M€ a 1 177 M€ ; plus-value Heathrow de 2 023 M€ avant impots sur la cession de 19,75%
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025, compte de resultat consolide : "Net profit/(loss) for the year attributed to the parent company 888 3,239 341" et "(72.6)%" dans le tableau de variation ; "Diluted 1.24 4.47 0.46 / Basic 1.24 4.47 0.46" ; "Operating profit/(loss) 1,177 3,109 625". Sur Heathrow : "Ferrovial completed the sale of 19.75% of the share capital of FGP Topco Ltd... with a capital gain of EUR 2,023 million" et tableau 2024 : "19,75% HAH Sale 2,023".
controles.correction_proposee: Precision utile : le 20-F indique que la Heathrow Transaction a genere au total 2 570 M€ de profit en 2024 (2 023 M€ sur les actions cedees + 547 M€ sur la participation de 5,25% conservee). Le chiffre de 2 023 M€ retenu par l'ATT est le bon pour la cession des 19,75%.

controles.affirmation: Construction 7 653 M€ soit 79,5% du CA groupe ; Autoroutes 1 374 M€ + Aeroports 111 M€ sur 9 627 M€ = 15,4% ; EBIT ajuste groupe 967 M€
controles.verbatim_source: data-lake/FER/segments_fr.json (extrait du 20-F FY2025, Item 5.A.7.1 Segment reporting) : Construction 7 653 M€ (79,49%), Autoroutes 1 374 M€ (14,27%), Energie 339 M€, Autres 150 M€, Aeroports 111 M€ (1,15%). 20-F FY2025 : "Revenues increased by 5.2% to EUR 9,627 million in 2025 from EUR 9,148 in 2024". kpis-haut FER : EBIT_ADJ FY2025 = 967 M€. Calcul (1 374 + 111)/9 627 = 15,43%.

controles.affirmation: Endettement net consolide de 5 893 M€ au 31 decembre 2025, en baisse par rapport aux 6 061 M€ de fin 2024 ; 7 234 M€ de dette de projets d'infrastructure ; perimetre hors projets en position de tresorerie nette de 1 341 M€
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025 : "CONSOLIDATED NET DEBT OF INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT COMPANIES 7,234 7,856 / CONSOLIDATED NET DEBT 5,893 6,061" et "Our Consolidated Net Debt decreased by EUR 168 million to EUR 5,893 million at December 31, 2025, from EUR 6,061 million at December 31, 2024. This decrease was driven by a net increase of EUR 454 million of our Consolidated Net Debt of ex-infrastructure project companies to EUR (1,341) million at December 31, 2025 from EUR (1,794) million at December 31, 2024."

controles.affirmation: Une faiblesse de controle interne a ete remediee au 31 decembre 2025 (mentionnee dans ce_qui_affaiblirait)
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025, 3.D.7.7 : "In our 2024 Form 20-F, filed with the SEC on February 28, 2025 (the '2024 20-F'), our management identified one material weakness in the design and operating effectiveness of our internal control over financial reporting ('ICFR'). We have concluded that the material weakness has been remediated as of December 31, 2025."

controles.affirmation: En excluant l'effet Heathrow 2024, le niveau 2025 reste superieur aux 341 M€ de 2023 et aux 188 M€ de 2022
controles.verbatim_source: 20-F FY2025, compte de resultat consolide : "Net profit/(loss) for the year attributed to the parent company 888 3,239 341" — le 341 M€ de 2023 est confirme. Le 20-F FY2025 ne presente que les exercices 2025, 2024 et 2023 : le chiffre de 188 M€ pour 2022 n'y figure pas et provient du 20-F FY2024, egalement cite dans les sources de l'ATT.
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune erreur, mais preciser la source du chiffre 2022 (20-F FY2024), le 20-F FY2025 ne couvrant pas cet exercice.

controles.affirmation: Coherence interne du bloc _sources concernant les 6-K
controles.verbatim_source: ATT FER, _sources : "6K de data-lake/FER/6K/ non utilises : pages de couverture sans exhibit financier chiffre". Or le bloc NTO cite explicitement comme source : "6-K S1 2026 (data-lake/FER/6K/FER_2026-07-28_0001628280-26-050224_interimmanagementreport.htm.gz, Operating Highlights)". Ce fichier existe (209 053 caracteres de texte) et contient bien les donnees chiffrees utilisees.
controles.correction_proposee: Defaut de documentation, sans consequence sur les faits. Le 6-K du 28 juillet 2026 EST utilise et constitue la source de l'information la plus recente de l'ATT (mars 2027 pour la Phase A DBO). Retirer la mention "6K non utilises" ou la restreindre aux seuls 6-K anterieurs.
